name: chord-transposer
description: Change keys, compare capo shapes, and print chord sheets.

interface.longDescription:
Keyshift Chord Transposer is an entertainment tool for playing chord sheets on guitar or ukulele. Paste chords above your own lyrics or ChordPro inline brackets, then change the key by semitones, a named key pair or a capo fret. Roots and slash bass notes move while quality text stays in place. Chord starts keep their columns unless longer names collide; later chords then move right with a separating space. Tabs use 8-column stops.

The live monospaced sheet has down and up semitone controls. A capo chart shows frets 0 to 9, the shapes to play and counts of easy open chord names. Transposition includes a printable PDF in a monospaced layout; long lines continue at shared column boundaries and chord/lyric pairs stay together.

Limits: 12,000 characters per sheet, semitone input -11 to +11, capo frets 0 to 9, and capo lists of 1 to 100 chords. Chord names only; no audio, tablature or staff notation. The key estimate uses the first and last chord and can be wrong for songs that change key. The PDF prints Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean lyrics. Chinese, Japanese and Korean characters take two columns, so chords stay over the right syllable. Right-to-left scripts such as Hebrew and Arabic, and emoji, get a note instead of a PDF. Lyrics are kept in widget-only metadata and an encrypted stateless download link, with no server-side lyric storage.
defaultPrompt: Transpose C  F  G  Am from C to F. Lyrics: Lanterns glow beside the gate.
Find capo options for the sounding chords D, G, A and Bm, for frets 0 to 9.
Show this chord sheet with key Am and semitone controls: [Am]Lantern [F]garden [C]glows [G]softly.

{"sheet": "Key: C
C        F        G
Lanterns glow beside the gate

positive.expected_behavior:
Transposed from C to G (+7 semitones); 6 chords, 4 unique chords, 2 lyric lines.
C -> G
F -> C
G -> D
Am -> Em
From the supplied origin key.
Capo 7 with C shapes sounds in G.

Transposed from C to A (-3 semitones); 4 chords, 4 unique chords, 0 lyric lines.
C -> A
G -> E
Am -> F#m
F -> D
From the supplied origin key.
Capo 9 with C shapes sounds in A.

Capo frets 0 to 9 for D. Shape pitch plus fret equals sounding pitch.
Fret 0: D, Em, F#m, G, A, Bm, C#dim; 4 easy open chords.
Fret 1: Db, Ebm, Fm, Gb, Ab, Bbm, Cdim; 0 easy open chords.
Fret 2: C, Dm, Em, F, G, Am, Bdim; 5 easy open chords.
Fret 3: B, C#m, D#m, E, F#, G#m, A#dim; 1 easy open chords.
Fret 4: Bb, Cm, Dm, Eb, F, Gm, Adim; 1 easy open chords.
Fret 5: A, Bm, C#m, D, E, F#m, G#dim; 3 easy open chords.
Fret 6: Ab, Bbm, Cm, Db, Eb, Fm, Gdim; 0 easy open chords.
Fret 7: G, Am, Bm, C, D, Em, F#dim; 5 easy open chords.
Fret 8: Gb, Abm, Bbm, B, Db, Ebm, Fdim; 0 easy open chords.
Fret 9: F, Gm, Am, Bb, C, Dm, Edim; 3 easy open chords.

negative.description: No tool call; chord names only, no audio input.

negative.description: No tool call; tablature and staff notation are outside the tool limits.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: The PDF now prints lyrics in Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean with a monospaced Noto font; chords stay aligned by display columns. Right-to-left lyrics and emoji get a note instead of a PDF, and the transposition still succeeds.

pl-PL.subtitle: Zmień tonację i akordy
pl-PL.description: Transponuj arkusze akordów i porównuj pozycje kapodastra od 0 do 9. Obsługiwane są akordy nad tekstem i zapis ChordPro. Limit: 12 000 znaków; PDF obsługuje alfabet łaciński, grecki, cyrylicę, wietnamski, chiński, japoński i koreański, bez pisma od prawej do lewej. Bez audio, tabulatur i nut. Szacowana tonacja może być błędna.

de-DE.subtitle: Tonart und Capo ändern
de-DE.description: Transponieren Sie Akkordblätter und vergleichen Sie Capo-Bünde von 0 bis 9. Akkorde über dem Text und ChordPro werden unterstützt. Grenze: 12.000 Zeichen; PDF unterstützt lateinische, griechische, kyrillische, vietnamesische, chinesische, japanische und koreanische Schrift, keine Schrift von rechts nach links. Kein Audio, keine Tabulatur oder Notenschrift. Die geschätzte Tonart kann falsch sein.

es-ES.subtitle: Cambia tonalidad y cejilla
es-ES.description: Transpone hojas de acordes y compara cejillas de 0 a 9. Admite acordes sobre letras y ChordPro. Límite: 12.000 caracteres; el PDF admite alfabeto latino, griego, cirílico, vietnamita, chino, japonés y coreano, sin escritura de derecha a izquierda. Sin audio, tablaturas ni partituras. La tonalidad estimada puede ser incorrecta.

fr-FR.subtitle: Tonalité et capo
fr-FR.description: Transposez des grilles et comparez les positions de capo de 0 à 9. Accords au-dessus du texte et ChordPro acceptés. Limite : 12 000 caractères ; PDF en alphabets latin, grec, cyrillique, vietnamien, chinois, japonais et coréen, sans écriture de droite à gauche. Sans audio, tablature ni notation musicale. La tonalité estimée peut être incorrecte.

ja-JP.subtitle: コード移調とカポ比較
ja-JP.description: コードシートを移調し、0〜9フレットのカポの形を比較します。歌詞の上のコードとChordProに対応。上限は12,000文字。PDFはラテン文字、ギリシャ文字、キリル文字、ベトナム語、中国語、日本語、韓国語に対応し、右から左に書く文字には非対応です。音声、タブ譜、五線譜には非対応。推定キーは誤る場合があります。

pt-BR.subtitle: Mude o tom e o capotraste
pt-BR.description: Transponha cifras e compare posições de capotraste de 0 a 9. Aceita acordes acima da letra e ChordPro. Limite: 12.000 caracteres; PDF aceita alfabeto latino, grego, cirílico, vietnamita, chinês, japonês e coreano, sem escrita da direita para a esquerda. Sem áudio, tablatura ou partitura. O tom estimado pode estar incorreto.
